    Features

    The answer to true immersion

    Key features at a glance

    Ask your companion anything. Samsung Vision AI is here.

    Samsung Vision AI Companion

    TV becomes an intelligent companion, with Vision AI Companion redefining screen interaction. Backed by 20+ years of TV insight, Vision AI Companion delivers context-aware, rich and dynamic answers — enhanced by leading AI agents like Gemini — all without interrupting what's on screen. It seamlessly adapts to daily routines, whether it's catching up on morning updates, tracking live sports moments, finding great nearby spots or discovering more about on-screen content. With AI, picture, sound and generative features are seamlessly connected and continuously evolving. 1

    Feel the full power of AI in 4K

    NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor

    The NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor uses the power of 20 AI neural networks to optimize picture and sound quality. The result is impressive performance, whether you're streaming shows, playing video games or watching live sports.2

    Compared to 2026 Neo QLED 4K (NQ4 AI Processor)

    More about
    Samsung Vision AI

    Man watches football on Samsung TV at night. Soundwaves emanate from TV's side and front. He speaks into remote control ‘Bixby, AI Football Mode ON’. AI Football Mode turns on, soundwaves show balanced crowd and commentator sound, and the field looks more crisp and vibrant than when it's off.3

    Your command, your match — AI-enhanced football viewing

    AI Soccer Mode

    Turn on AI‑driven picture and sound tuning when watching soccer. Richer colours, dynamic contrast, and prioritized commentator voice let you follow every pass and cheer with professional‑level clarity. 3

    Woman watches musical performance on a Samsung TV. Below it, AI Sound Controller shows volume levels for the audio as two separate tracks: Voice and Background. As she speaks into the remote control ‘I want to hear the singing louder’, it adjusts to increase Voice and reduce Background.4

    Separate and control audio layers — voice and sound effects — with a single command

    AI Sound Controller

    AI Sound Controller uses AI to analyze real-time audio and separate it into two tracks — voice and sound effects. Using the on-screen menu or voice commands, you can then adjust the volume of each track to create a personalized listening experience for TV shows, movies and games. 4

    Scene of women talking at a cafe. Prompt ‘Try subtitles in your language’ and Live Translate button appears. Translate into English is pressed. Translating subtitles. Speed may vary based on the subtitles. Subtitles appear. ‘We wanted to do this for you.’ ’This is incredible! Thank you!’5

    Translate content into your language in real time

    Live Translate

    Break language barriers with Live Translate. On device AI detects the language of your content and instantly translates it into your preferred language. 5

    Unlock your imagination, Choose your keyword theme, Nature, Party mood, Relax in Cozy, Happy Holiday, Deco, Inspire me. Number of attempts. Nature click. What appeals to you? 3 images, Regenerate, Generate New. Regenerate click. 3 new images. Middle image click. Your generated image has been saved.6

    Make your own mood-matching wallpapers with AI

    Generative Wallpaper

    With Generative Wallpaper, your TV can create stunning, one-of-a-kind images that reflect the moment and transform the ambiance of your home. Simply choose keywords for the atmosphere you want — whether you are hosting a party, enjoying time with family or relaxing — and let AI work its magic. 6

    Picture Quality

    Our advanced Mini LED Technology

    Quantum Mini LED

    Experience ultra-fine contrast with Quantum Mini LED, precisely controlled by Quantum Matrix Technology. Innovative backlighting technology featuring Quantum Mini LED delivers sharp and accurate contrast.

    Real Colours, Real QLED. You deserve nothing less.

    Real QLED with 100% Colour Volume

    Vibrant and accurate colors amplified by Samsung’s Quantum Dot sheet that delivers 100% color volume. 7

    More about
    Picture Quality

    Image of a little girl kissing a puppy. The NQ4 AI Gen2 Processor appears on the photo and enhances several details, including the girl’s hair and clothes and the puppy’s face. The result is a much sharper image where subtle details are visible.8

    Upscale content into a 4K experience

    4K AI Upscaling

    Our 4K AI Upscaling technology powered by 20 AI neural networks transforms content into near 4K resolution. 8

    Elevate your 4K viewing with superb brightness and vivid colours

    NQ HDR+

    Upgrade your viewing pleasure with stunning brightness and dynamically adaptive scenes in 4K resolution. NQ HDR+ delivers a more vibrant colour experience enhanced by a higher dynamic range, making your favorite content look more rich and lifelike. 9

    A Samsung TV displays a jungle scene. It looks a bit dull until several points are detected and then enhanced thanks to Colour Booster Pro. The result is an amazingly vibrant picture with all the colours of the flowers and birds clearly standing out.

    Intelligently enhanced colour expression with AI

    Colour Booster Pro

    Colour Booster Pro uses AI to recognize each scene and enhance colour expression accordingly. The result is imagery that appears more vivid and dynamic, creating a viewing experience that feels remarkably realistic.

    Scene of merry-go-round at amusement park. It looks a bit dull until Auto HDR Remastering spotlights areas to be enhanced for Vibrant Colours, Clearer Details and Bright Highlights. Then it enhances everything, so the scene appears more detailed and lifelike.10

    Enjoy HDR-like quality even with SDR content

    Auto HDR Remastering

    Using deep learning algorithms, Auto HDR Remastering learns to identify SDR and HDR content, and then converts SDR content into brilliant HDR-like quality. Now you can enjoy brighter highlights, clearer details and more vibrant colours throughout your viewing experience. 10

    Depth perceived just as a person’s eyes would

    Real Depth Enhancer

    Real Depth Enhancer now mirrors how human eyes process depth by increasing foreground contrast. So when you are watching a nature documentary, it enhances an elephant’s wrinkles while leaving the background as it is – just as a person’s eyes would.

    Enjoy authentic colour validated by PANTONE, only on Samsung screens

    PANTONE Validated

    Fully authentic and accurate colour validated by PANTONE. ‘PANTONE Validated’ provides validation on accurate expression of 2,140 PANTONE colours and newly added 110 skin tone shades. Enjoy a stunning and comfortable watching experience! 11

    Gaming Experience

    Get smooth motion for games up to 4K 144Hz, 2K 240Hz with VRR

    Motion Xcelerator 144Hz

    Enjoy seamless visuals at incredibly fast speeds with Motion Xcelerator 144Hz. Samsung’s unique dynamic refresh technology provides smooth motion performance for VRR games up to 4K 144 Hz or 2K 240Hz.12

    Where gaming comes together

    Gaming Hub

    Samsung Tizen OS now acts as a convenient conduit to your favourite cloud gaming platforms (no console required), console games, and standalone apps. It displays game recommendations based on what games you like to play, so you can quickly find your next favorite games. 13

    More about
    Gaming Experience

    Two people gaming on a Samsung TV. They switch between various games, including a football game, a racing game and a first-person shooter game. With AI Gaming Optimizer on, the TV automatically detects the type of game being played.14

    Play smarter — perfect settings, every match

    AI Gaming Optimizer

    AI Gaming Optimizer auto-detects game genres via real-time screen analysis and automatically applies optimized settings: No manual menus – just instant, genre‑specific optimization. 14

    Tear-free, stutter-free, low latency HDR gaming

    FreeSync Premium Pro

    Built on AMD FreeSync™ core technology to reduce stutter and screen tearing, AMD FreeSync™ Premium Pro provides a true HDR gaming experience. It combines smooth gaming at peak performance and exceptional high dynamic range visuals, all while maintaining low latency for seamless gameplay. 15

    Optimize your gaming experience

    Game Bar

    Bigger and wider TV screens with 21:9 and 32:9 ratios allows you to have more viewing area and gives you an immersive gaming experience. Game Bar allows you to optimize your gameplay such as screen ratio adjustment, mini map zoom, virtual aim point, input lag check, FPS, HDR, VRR and more. 16

    Sound

    A next level Dolby Atmos experience with top channel speakers

    Dolby Atmos®

    The Dolby Atmos experience will immerse you inside the action with multi dimensional sound. With the addition of Samsung’s top channel speakers and Dolby Atmos, the TV delivers an incredible audio experience.

    Sound

    Experience sound as the artist intended with remastering and intelligent processing

    Adaptive Sound Pro

    Adaptive Sound Pro optimizes sound considering characteristics of both the room and audio content. Experience improved voice clarity and vivid yet balanced sound just as the creators intended, thanks to the unique audio remastering technology that uses neural processing to extract and process sound objects. 17

    Be fully immersed into the content with virtual sound that tracks the action

    Object Tracking Sound Lite

    A 3D surround sound with our virtual top channel audio will allow you to be fully immersed in the audio experience.

    A TV shows a concert scene. When Q-Symphony is off, the soundbar under the TV plays audio by itself, giving off small sound waves. When Q-Symphony is on, the TV and soundbar play audio together, with both giving off large sound waves in sync.18

    TV and soundbar orchestrated in perfect harmony

    Q-Symphony

    Experience supreme audio immersion through AI-powered synergy between TV and soundbar pre-learned through thousands of sources. This powerful duo simultaneously creates next-level surround sound experience for diverse scenes. 18

    Personalize your screen experience

    One UI Tizen

Your One UI Tizen experience is secured by Samsung Knox, increasing protection across all your SmartThings devices. One UI Tizen will also support Tizen OS upgrades for the next seven years.19

    A global art gallery at home

    Art Store

    Transform your space Samsung Art TV with over 5,000 inspiring and curated artworks from the world's leading museums, galleries, and artists—including timeless classics, modern masters, and contemporary icons—to perfectly match every season, holiday, and mood.21

    Relive your favorite memories with Google Photos for Samsung TV

    Google Photos for Samsung TV

    Google Photos is the home for all your life’s memories. Rediscover your favorite photos, both new and old, with daily curated memories from Google Photos and enjoy seeing the people, trips and activities that matter most on your Samsung TV. 22

    One UI Tizen

    Access subscription free TV. Stream shows and movies you know and love.

    Samsung TV Plus

    Get access to subscription free TV and enjoy your favorite content on Samsung TV Plus. Watch news, sports, movies, exclusive events, K content, creators and more, live and on demand. 23

    Samsung TV in a living room switches on to display Now Brief interface as it detects a person stepping towards the TV. The Now Brief interface displays information on the weather, recommended content and smart-home updates.24

    Access useful info throughout the day even when your TV is off

    Now Brief

    Provide useful information throughout the day even when the TV is turned off. You can customize your Now brief with loads of widgets such as Weather, Memo, SmartThings, Music and more. Now brief wakes up hands-free through voice activation or when you get near your TV. 24

    Your privacy. Secured.

    Samsung Knox Security

    All of your TV experiences are secured by Knox. Samsung Knox Security secures against harmful attacks by automatically block execution of unauthorized malicious apps or access to phishing sites, and even secures your home IoT devices connected to your TV. So your sensitive data such as pin codes or passwords are protected by multiple layers of software and hardware. Lastly, Samsung’s dedicated security team helps keep your TV safe with constant updates. Your privacy is now secured on Samsung TVs. 25

    SmartThings

    Do the SmartThings!

    SmartThings

    Optimize your home devices for a smart lifestyle tailored to your needs enhanced with our built in SmartThings Hub. Enjoy a customized smart home with many SmartThings compatible devices that simplify your day to day life. Additionally, utilize your screen as an IoT sensor to care for your loved ones and expand your TV’s role in managing your home via 3D Map View.26

    More about
    SmartThings

    A Galaxy smartphone displays Quick Remote mode, which is used to increase the volume of a nearby TV as it shows a scene of a woman playing guitar.27

    Control your TV straight from your phone

    Quick Remote

    With Quick Remote in the SmartThings app, your phone works as a remote, letting you change channels, manage volume and more — straight from your mobile device. You can also access key Samsung Tizen TV features, explore media and adjust settings with ease. 27

    A dog barks in a living room as a Samsung TV sits turned off at the center of the space. The TV detects the sound through the Pet Care function and automatically turns on, playing a calming video of a dog at play.28

    Stay connected to your pets while you're away

    Pet Care

    Use your TV as a pet-sitting assistant while you're outside. Your TV can detect noises like barking through its microphone, and then automatically turn on your pet's favorite content to calm them down. 28

    Your Galaxy media, instantly on the big screen

    Storage Share

    Enjoy your favorite moments on a bigger screen with ease. Storage Share lets you stream photos, videos and more from your Galaxy devices directly to your TV. With automatic detection of nearby devices, sharing content across Samsung devices feels seamless and effortless. 29

    When AI Energy Mode is off, the surroundings around the TV appear bright. A smartphone screen displaying AI Energy Mode pops up, and it switches from Off to On. With adaptive brightness and AI Energy Mode activated, the energy level decreases significantly, and the scale shifts from day to night.30

    Save energy use by intelligently analyzing your surrounding, behaviors and content

    AI Energy Mode

    Easy energy management with SmartThings. By turning on AI Energy Mode, it auto detects surrounding light levels and analyzes usage behaviors to adjust the brightness. It analyzes the content scene by scene to subtly adjust brightness and help save energy consumption where possible. 30

    Transform your TV into a karaoke stage

    Karaoke

    Transform your TV into a karaoke stage, with your phone as the mic or wireless microphones. Start singing with friends and family, filling your living room with fun, energy and lively entertainment. 31
